summary_md: **Karl Mehta ([@karlmehta](https://x.com/karlmehta/status/2115834904739033160))** explains an MCP Python SDK advisory (CVSS 6.8) where server bearer auth did not check a token's audience claim, so tokens for other services were accepted, a confused-deputy issue also disclosed in the AWS API MCP Server; upgrading only helps once `validate_token_resource=True` is set ([GHSA-w4fh-qvv9-3v23](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/security/advisories/GHSA-w4fh-qvv9-3v23), [AWS advisory](https://github.com/awslabs/mcp/security/advisories/GHSA-4prq-p2x5-w9fh)).

referenced_urls.title: Server bearer-token authentication accepts tokens issued for a different resource server

relevance: Concrete MCP server security fix harness builders must configure.
